title: Bret Weinstein and Yuri Deigin: Did Covid-19 leak From a Lab?
summary: Bret Weinstein and Yuri Deigin discuss the evidence for the hypothesis that SARS-CoV-2 leaked from a lab, including the furin cleavage site and gain-of-function research. The conversation draws on Deigin's Medium article.
why: HN commenters shared it in 2020 and 2021 as an early, in-depth presentation of the lab-leak case, though it is a contested viewpoint.

quote.text: he had a very interesting conversation with a russian virologist who also thinks this is the case
